responses.text: Hi there. Welcome to the Westside Co-op. I'm Clayton Ettienne. Let me know if you have any questions.
Welcome back. How can I help you?
Uh... hi.
It might not look like much, but it's what keeps us Westside locals independent.
We started it a few years ago. I admit, we had a lot of trouble at first, but eventually we got some help from Tom Anderson with the Followers.
We're finally to the point where the co-op members can start making money from sales instead of just breaking even.
All right.

topics.prompt: Show me what you have for sale.

responses.text: See you later.
Oh... that. Yes. Anderson filled me in on the details. Just let me know when you'd like your... order to be filled.

topics.prompt: I'm here to talk to you about our new "business" arrangement.

responses.text: {sighing} Yes, it just came in. Here's all of it.
I'm sorry, but your order won't be in for a while. Please come back in a day or two.
Well, I've lived in Nevada all my life. Started out in New Reno, but headed down here as soon as I got the chance.
If you can believe it, things are even worse back home. The whole city's still run by crime families. Used to be the Mordinos and Wrights.
Now it's the Wrights and Van Graffs. Seems like things never get better. Anyway, that's all behind me now.
Uh... okay, look... first, I didn't have anything to do with that trooper. That was all Anderson.
Second, even though the whole scheme was Anderson's idea, it's the only way the co-op could stay in business. The water means everything.

topics.prompt: I know how the Westside farmers have been getting their water.

responses.text: It was Hector's idea, if you can believe it. He overheard me talking to Anderson about his idea to divert the water over here.
We needed someone to be able to go into the cisterns and get the water out, but any of us would be suspicious. Hector volunteered.
He said that no one pays attention to him, even with his brahmin. Anderson and I argued, but eventually we decided to let him go ahead with it.
Look, this affects all of us, even Hector. What were we supposed to do, let all of our gardens die? Watch Westside fall apart?

topics.prompt: Whose idea was it to use the kid?

responses.text: Pretty much what you'd expect. White talked to Hector and then went to talk to Anderson.
White made the mistake of assuming that because Anderson's a Follower of the Apocalypse, he wouldn't try anything.
Anderson acted docile, but as soon as White turned to go, Anderson shot him in the back. At least that's what Anderson told me.

topics.prompt: What went down with Anderson and Corporal White?

responses.text: Wait... what are you going to do?
You're the one who should be worried. Good luck.

topics.prompt: I'm going to have a chat with Anderson. Don't worry.

responses.text: Please, just... don't let them shut down the co-op.
Fuck!

topics.prompt: Hope you're not too attached to this place.

responses.text: See you later.
